decisions.reason: The ID Vault feature complements the core identity platform and is inexpensive to maintain while its standalone demand remains uncertain, so the option is kept open.
An identity-bound payment wallet remains a strategic option in digital payments, and the firm can wait for regulatory and market uncertainty to resolve before committing further.
NFC-based login is an exploratory authentication option with unresolved adoption, and keeping it open preserves learning without large sunk costs.
The secure payment and wallet framework is a core component of the super-app platform and has shown enough commitment to justify continued investment.
This is the firm's core multi-service app platform and has the highest strategic option value, making withdrawal very unlikely.
Application shielding leverages the firm's existing security expertise and remains a valuable option for protecting customer apps, with low cost to keep.
